Biome: Plains — the village shore: tents scattered here and in the Harbour (pod 15), NO fence between them

Task: Queue up 5 trees for felling (Option+click — the queue lesson) and fell 5 trees — the RIVER GATE then opens: wade in at the chamber-wall gap (the spring rises hard against the centre wall — no walking behind it) and ride the current down through the gate to the Cove (no dry road) SHORTCUT with this gate: Landing<->Cove arch on the -54deg spoke.
Brace yourself in the water (hold Shift in the current), then catch 5 whitebait; the river below the gate runs fence-free to the sea

GOALS: light the furnace (wield the knife, strike the flint, stoke with logs; mānuka rākau + Firemaking 3 for iron heat) and forge the four pieces — iron shortsword, 30 iron arrowheads (2 anvil batches), bronze chainbody, bronze targe. Equipping is advised but NOT required. The terrace is an EXACT ore ledger (only ore on the isle; natural rocks stripped) counted in SIX-BAR FURNACE FIRINGS: 8 copper rocks x7 = 56 ore (8 copper firings = 48 bars @120xp + 8 copper into bronze), 2 tin rocks x2 = 4 (two bronze firings: 4 copper + 2 tin -> 6 bars @150xp each), 5 iron rocks x6 = 30 (five iron firings -> 30 bars; the forge spends ~22). 8x120 + 2x150 = 1260 xp = Smelting 3 (7 firings = 1140 falls short). Mining xp crosses Ore-mining 2 at ore 22 and 3 (iron rock req) at 39
Skills Unlocked: Stone-mining, Ore-mining, Gem-mining, Smelting, Weaponsmithing, Armoursmithing, Firemaking

Task: The motu errand: swim to the offshore islet (seated PER CHARACTER just past bare-lungs range — equip the snorkel or drown a few strokes short; no hull can cross), open the sea chest, bring the pearl back TO VRIXA. Riding the river to its Source stays optional SHORTCUTS with this gate: Forge<->Bank chamber (RM ring at 0deg) and Bush<->Bank chamber (a 3-arch lane through the -45deg wall + both river-bank fences, wading the channel).
Deposit an item; saw planks & make 9 empty pails at the carpenter's bench SHORTCUT with this gate: Bush chamber<->Farm crown (centre wall at -90deg).

The fenced 5x5 farm at the crown centre (one gate, east side): harvest 20 EACH of wheat, potatoes, apples, sageleaves & flax (one good picking of each row; replanting taught but optional); mill 10 flour; collect 10 eggs; collect 10 feathers (= exactly the fletching budget for 30 arrows); SPLIT-SELVES LESSON: press X and keep both selves working at once (one farms the regrow cycles, the other roams) — Kenji points out his SHORTCUT gate in the 45-degree chamber wall (bank chamber -> woodcraft chamber), which unbars with this stage
Skills Unlocked: Cerealiculture, Olericulture, Pomiculture, Herbiculture, Fibriculture, Milling, Husbandry

Task: MERGE your selves back into one (X, side by side — the two roads from the farm converge here); cut 300 arrow shafts (20 cuts — lands Fletching 2, the level iron arrows demand), fletch 30 iron arrows (2 batches: 15 shafts + 5 feathers + 15 heads), carve a shortbow (req 2 — the shaft ladder lands it). NO wand — magic is not taught on the isle SHORTCUT with this gate: Lagoon<->Cooking arch on the 54deg spoke.
Cook 5 whitebait fritters, 1 cottage cheese (milk the cows with your pails — Husbandry 3), 5 flatbread (your flint from the Forge lights the fires)
Slay 3 slimes; gather 3 tallow, 3 hide, 3 action runes, 3 state runes; slay 5 koreke on the wing (archery)

Char your logs into wood ash, boil soap with your warden's tallow, and scrub off all your stink SHORTCUTS with this gate: Bush<->Sky (225deg wall), Wood<->Sky (135deg wall), Crown<->Sky (centre wall at 180deg). (Warden<->Sky was requested but shares no border - the war->soap->sky gates already chain it.)
Climb the Sky Knoll; SAY something to Ravenna (Enter) and hear a real semantic-chat answer — her first page sells the wonder: no scripts, no generated words, real retrieved speech
Sky After: 6:15pm clear (dusk settles — from here on, finished keepers walk home to the Harbour Village and its lamps light one by one)

Task: Spin harvested flax into linen & wick, dip a rushlight, and equip it SHORTCUT with this gate: Bush chamber<->Portal Crown sector (RM ring at -130.5deg).
Craft 50 air runes at the runestone altar (Runecrafting — no spellcasting taught)

Biome: Plains — the village shore, continuous with the Landing (no fence)
Task: Ferry to Newhaven (no task). The village green holds the keepers' tents; everyone met through the day gathers here after dusk
